Results.ReviewText: Second Weber grill that I have purchased, great products.
Results.Title: Great grill !

Results.ReviewText:
I can’t say enough good things about this grill.  The size is perfect for what we are looking for.  It’s so easy to move and the side tables fold down to take up less space on the deck. 

I have used this grill every week and enjoy how easy it is to light.  

I have had other grills but a Weber grill is the best.  A solid grill and you can get parts and service very easily.
Results.Title: This grill rocks !!!!!

Results.ReviewText: We bought this at the beginning of the month. We love that the grill has the option to tell us how muvch propane is left. Takes guess work out of the equation.
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: After 10 years of faithful service, my old Weber Spirit E-200 needed to be replaced.  After reading the reviews of competing brands, as well as Weber's, I was convinced I made the right choice 10 years ago.  So what did I buy?  A new Weber Spirit E-210 of course.  It's just the right size for our small porch.  It does everything I need it to do.  And if I get another 10 years out of the new one like the last - I'll be one happy camper.
Results.Title: I replaced my old Weber with a new Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: I went back to Weber Grills after having used another manufacturer for many years.  The best part of getting the Spirit were the clear and concise instructions provided by Weber.  Especially, on ensuring the grill is hot enough to start grilling.  Also, this grill is easier to clean and maintain than the competitors model I've been using for almost ten years.
Results.Title: Simple to Use ... Great Results

Results.ReviewText: We bought this Weber product about one month ago. So far we have been quite happy with the way it preforms. We look forward to use on a yearly basis.
Results.Title: Our new E210 Grill

Results.ReviewText: I have used it more in the last 3 weeks then my old grill in the last 2 years!
Results.Title: Really quick heat up. Super easy.

Results.ReviewText: Glad we finally got this product.....excellent....
Results.Title: Great grill....love it....

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill several months ago and it is made of quality materials and cooks evenly. Only complaint would be the scale mechanism that holds the gas tank; its made of plastic and seems like it may not hold up to the weight of the tanks for the life of the grill?
Results.Title: Best grill Ive ever owned

Results.ReviewText:
Bought one for my husband and he loves it!
Best propane grill he has ever owned. 
Cooks outstandingly well, very even and maintains heat.
Results.Title: Definitely recommend this grill

Results.ReviewText: This Weber grill was exactly what I was looking for.
Results.Title: Perfect grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased a Spirit E-210 back in 2013 and have used it multiple times per week ever since. It shows some age but is still working like a champ. I’ve had to replace the flavor bars once and going on a second set, and I’m just now having to replace the grates. This to me is awesome because I’ve used and abused this thing for 6 years now.
Results.Title: Everything I expected.

Results.ReviewText: My husband is very happy with his new weber grill. And says it is the best grill we ever had!
Results.Title: Best grill we ever had!

Results.ReviewText: Bought in June 2019 easy to put together looks and works great gave it a 4 star because the BTU's could be a little bit higher altogether a great barbecue for the price !
Results.Title: Great Barbecue !!

Results.ReviewText: We are happy with our purchase.  It is working well and looks good!
Results.Title: It is a perfect size for a small space !

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Weber, purchased for a seasonal home.  Our original Weber Genesis SIlver is 19 years old and still going strong.  We didn't hesitate to buy another.  More initial cost, but a lower cost overall when you consider the long life of these well made , durable grills.  We assembled it in a few hours, and one screw was defective- easily remedied with a call to customer service, whose friendly assistance soon had a replacement on the way.
Results.Title: Great Grill, Performance, and Investment

Results.ReviewText: We bought this grill about a month ago, assembled it fairly easily by following the excellent set of instructions, placed it on our back deck, and have cooked on it a few times. It is well built, easy to operate, and cooks excellently. We are fully satisfied.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: Weber has some of the best grills money can buy, pricey but well worth it. This 2 burner grill is perfect for my wife and I and is a solid investment.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Superb grill racks, easy to clean and your food doesn't stick. Very even cooking!
Results.Title: Best grill I have bought in 40 years!

Results.ReviewText:
Went to store to buy Spirit 2 but also looked at the original Spirit model also on display.  Spirit 2 felt flimsy and looked ugly compared to the original.  Even though Spirit 2 was on sale for $350 I ended up paying $400 for the original Spirit model because it felt more solid, looked sleeker, and allowed both shelves to fold.
(The sales guy said Weber screwed up with the design of the new model and they probably will discontinue it.  He also said the original Spirit model was outselling Spirit 2 significantly and I can understand why).
After a month of grilling, I'm very happy with the performance of the grill.
Results.Title: Worth the money

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. It cooks my food easier than my old grill. The whole cooking experience is so much better. I really like the temperature gage on the outside as it helps monitor the cooking process
Results.Title: Lovely, Simple, Easy

Results.ReviewText: I got this grill for Father's Day.  I've used it several times since and have been very pleased with the cooking results.  The burners heat the cast iron grid very evenly.  No more moving the meat around the grate to avoid the hot and cold spots.  Temperature gauge is large and easy to read.  The two folding side tables allow me to store the grill in the corner and out of the way.  The grill appears to be very sturdy and solid.  I look forward to years of trouble free usage.
Results.Title: Love this grill...!

Results.ReviewText: I got this a Month ago and has met my expectations.
Results.Title: Just the right size and accessories I wanted

Results.ReviewText: We have not grilled for years because we did not enjoy the quality of the food that came from our grill.  For years we were sure my husband was jinxed with an inept grilling gene.  Recently we decided to give grilling one more try and this time we decided to not buy the grill that was on sale or the more economically priced one.  We had been told for years about Weber grills and their quality so before we went shopping we did some research and found that the Weber Spirit got very high reviews and . . . well the rest is history.  Now we can't get enough, we want to grill every evening.  It is amazing how good food tastes when the grill does not flare up and turn it in to a hockey puck.  I have to go now and cook some hamburgers!
Results.Title: Buy a Weber Today!!

Results.ReviewText: Très satisfaite. Un peu long à assembler mais les instructions étaient très claires.
Results.Title: Parfait

Results.ReviewText: I bought one three years ago for the lake I was so impressed, I just bought one for home
Results.Title: Great grill just the right size

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill, the last Weber grill I owned lasted 17 years!   Use it several times a week. Easy to start and sides fold down for compact storage
Results.Title: Easy to use, compact, light enough to move around,

Results.ReviewText: I bought this project because of all the great reviews
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: I needed a new grill and decided that this time I was going t buy quality. So, I bought a Traeger, only to find that the thermostat was defective. Then I found that the replacement would not arrive until the end of September. So back it went. And, I bought my Weber. So glad I did. The grill space in incredible for such a small grill. I grill almost every night in the summer and I couldn't be happier. So glad that I made the right choice, finally.
Results.Title: Easy and fun!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this 3weeks ago, two burners heat up the grill the fastest of any. I have owned.   Gets very hot in a short time, never have to cook at wide open.  Love the instant ignition.
Results.Title: Hot and fast

Results.ReviewText: Downsized our grill after owning a huge stainless steel model, haven’t missed it one bit! My new Weber is so easy to use and cooks evenly, cleans up so much easier. Had a portable Weber grill  for camping and knew we needed one for home too!
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText:
Bought this grill a few weeks ago and have used it a half dozen times. I LOVE this Grill! It's the perfect size for our deck, the side tables fold flat making it a "skinny minnie"!  The grill top handles enough food for two people or a small group depending on the meal. I also love the fact that the propane tank fits in the enclosed cabinet and the casters allow the grill to be moved, with the enclosed tank,  when necessary.
I would absolutely recommend the Spirit Grill!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill!

Results.ReviewText: Bought this two months ago.  Like how it cooks. Cooks so even it doesn’t burn the food. Wish it cooked faster but the food comes out golden brown
Results.Title: Just a nice unit

Results.ReviewText: I have trouble with the grates, They have to be turned upside down to have a flat cooking surface. I hope someone from Weber will reach out to me about this problem
Results.Title: Nice grill

Photos.Caption: Easy start, easy clean, temp gets hot! Love my new grill!

Results.ReviewText:
Great size, temp gets hot for grilling flavor, easy to clean & start!. Feels safe to use! 
Love my new grill!
Results.Title: Features and size

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this grill for a rather compact space at me beach house.  I find the quality to be excellent, it is very stylish, the cooking surface is the perfect size, the gas gauge makes it easy to know if I need to have another tank on hand, and when the side shelves are folded down it is compact. So far, I feel that the premium price is justified.
Results.Title: Exactly what I was searching for!

Results.ReviewText: Bought 1month ago. So far excellent job. Saved my money for a while to buy it
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: It was a surprise Father’s Day gift from my daughter—just like the one she has at home.  Up until then I was a charcoal guy using a classic Weber kettle, and would not have gone to propane without a serious nudge.  Since then I have become a true believer.
Results.Title: Happy Father’s Day!

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Webber grill. Customer service is wonderful.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is the best gas grill I have ever purchased.  It lights quickly, the heat seems to be even and with this particular Weber gas grill, the propane tank is hidden in the cabinet. So nice to have a grill that works well!
Results.Title: Love it!

Results.ReviewText: Ingenious tank capacity gauge. And is capable of quick reaching of high temperature for grilling.
Results.Title: One very good grill!

Results.ReviewText: I bought the grill in June and love it!  It is very easy to grill all types of foods.
Results.Title: Wonderful

Results.ReviewText: Top notch build quality combined with features make my Spirit the grill of choice in this price category.
Results.Title: Great features.

Results.ReviewText: I recently bought this grill as a first time griller. My grandson and I decided it was time for us to start grilling this summer. We read all the instructions and followed them and found out that it was quite easy to grill.  I didn’t want an oversized grill and this one is compact, two side shelf’s fold down when not in use, the propane tank has a spot inside with an access door which is a very nice feature and it has a scale to let you know when the tank is low.  I definitely recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Easy to use grill

Results.ReviewText: unfortunately this grill does not got hot enough and grilling is very difficult and time consuming
Results.Title: does not get hot

Results.ReviewText: This is the 2nd E-210 that we've owned.   The first one, a long time wonderful partner in many an grilling experience.  Simply died, it was 11 years old....It still worked but the bottom had rusted where the sides meet, and was no longer safe.  Weber makes all the parts available to make it right, but it was time for a replacement.   Off to Lowe's and purchased this new one, and it's working just like the other.   In fact I've decided to hook it up to my whole house propane gas system tank and never have to go fetch another tank refill.   We love this grill and use it year round, even cooking our traditional Steaks on Christmas Day, regardless of weather.
Results.Title: ideal features....particularly the CLOSEd IN tank

Results.ReviewText: I’ve has my Weber for about a month, and I love it. I hung on to my old grill a season or two too long, and this new purchase has been great.
Results.Title: So far, so good

Results.ReviewText: Well built, looks good, tough, durable, everything about the grill is just amazing. Highly recommend anyone to buy any Weber. Customer service is top notch  has as well.
Results.Title: amazing grill

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size for the two of us - plus it handles everything when we have company.  Small foot print when folded makes for more space on the patio when it is not in use.   The quality and ease of use are the icing on the cake.  Glad we purchased it.
Results.Title: Perfect size

Results.ReviewText: From the get-go this grill hasn't been that reliable, as it seemed to be tricky getting it to start.  Now, after 2 years, we are disappointed that it no longer works at all.  We emailed customer service and eventually received a new starter, but despite replacement of the starter, it doesn't start as it should..
Results.Title: After Only 2 Years, the Grill Doesn't Work

Results.ReviewText: Family surprised me with a new grill for Father's Day and I couldn't be happier with this Weber.  Grill was already assembled and I found out the ignitor was bad.  A quick call to Weber service and they expedited a replacement unit within a few days.  Everything works great now.
Results.Title: First Weber Gas Grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased this 2 burner grill to replace a 3 burner Weber that I have been using for over 15 years. The 2 burner works great and has more than enough cooking space.Weber always stands by their product.I would never by any other brand
Results.Title: Fantastic grill!!

Results.ReviewText: Bought the Spirit E-210 a month ago. Love that the LP tank stores behind a door. The smaller grill heats fast and to a perfect temperature for grilling chicken pieces and burgers. Love this grill!
Results.Title: Perfect Heat

Results.ReviewText: Fits great on a deck and doesn't take up much room when opened up.
Results.Title: Great Grill for the Deck

Results.ReviewText: This grill is classy, compact, and so easy to use. I love how easy it is to roll it around.  The ignition is instantaneous. I like the two side tables that you can use or fold down. I like the grilling surfaces, which allows you to use either side depending on what you are grilling. I recommend!
Results.Title: My third Weber

Results.ReviewText: We have been very happy with our recent purchase.  Has exceeded all expectations to date.  A little more expensive than some of the competition, but worth the extra money.  The food cooks very even and the grill heats up very quickly.  I like the grates a lot more compared to what I had on my recent char broil.  Only negative was Lowes installed the tank hanger upside down.  No fault on Weber and was an easy fix.
Results.Title: Weber 210 gas grill

Results.ReviewText: This is my first Weber, wish I had purchased this grill sooner.
Results.Title: Super grill and cooks really well.

Results.ReviewText: We really love this grill. It provides even cooking unlike other grills we have owned in the past. It is easy to clean too.
Results.Title: Very dependable grill

Results.ReviewText: I recently purchased this grill and am completely satisfied with it. It lives up to the Weber name. Quality made cook grill.
Results.Title: Excellent grill !

Results.ReviewText: My husband and I have always used a charcoal grill, but we noticed we were using it less frequently. It occurred to us that we might use the more convenient gas grill more, and this has proved to be the case. After researching small grills, we decided on this one, and we have been very pleased with its performance.
Results.Title: Lives up to its fine reputation

Results.ReviewText: Really good grill but the wheels are to small. When I try to roll it across my deck the wheels get stuck in the gaps between the decking. Poor design, My 20 year Weber with lager wheels no problem. I would not recommend this grill if  you have wood decking.
Results.Title: Good grill, Bad wheels

Results.ReviewText: So far so good but igniter doesn’t work well.  No clicking sound to tell you it is working.
Results.Title: Igniter

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill.  Even cooking temperatures, nice wide grate so food doesn't fall through, and the best grill to keep grease trap clean. Best warranty I've ever seen. Well worth the price.  One word to caution, for some reason the lid handle will get extremely hot.  Use mitts.
Results.Title: Great small grill

Results.ReviewText:
I had a couple of minor issues when I assembled our new Spirit E210. The response from 
Weber was immediate and they made an offer to replace the problem parts right away. Couldn't ask for better service...and we are enjoying our new grill immensely. This is our second Weber grill and not our last, for sure.
Results.Title: Great Service

Results.ReviewText: We have a small patio area and needed to replace charcoal grill - my son has the bigger model and recommended this for us.  It is easy to use, heats quickly - though using single burner doesn't heat unit as quickly and recommended heating times (I find) need increasing - and fits our space just right!
Results.Title: Fits perfectly!

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber charcoal grill. I also had a bigger Weber Gas Grill. I gave my gas grill to my daughter and kept the charcoal grill but I want to grill more and not have it take so long so I bought a smaller grill.  I love my grill and grill all the time now.
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: I’m happy with the grill. It is fairly easy to keep up with keeping if it clean. It cools down very quickly.
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: I've had my Weber since Father's Day, what a great gift.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: We purchased this grill a few weeks ago and have used it many times.  We are now retired with only two of us at home.  It is the perfect size for us.  We can cook an entire meal for us or grill burgers for friends and family.  The grease system is amazing and easy to clean.  we love it!!
Results.Title: Love this Grill

Results.ReviewText: My first Weber. Had heard how good they were and the stories are not wrong. I have used it multiple times now and I love it. No more moving my food around to find the right spot. Cooks great every time.
Results.Title: Love this Grill

Results.ReviewText: This is our second Spirit in 4 years. Really did did not want to by another one because the cabinet  rusted through at the base. This time I coated the cabinet with a clear matte sealer before assembly. Hopefully we’ll enjoy this grill even longer. Gotta go with quality!!!!
Results.Title: Gotta go with Grill quality.

Results.ReviewText: Excellent product. I enjoy the door on the bottom storage area. Just big enough for the two of us. Comes on fast, cooks quickly, job is done.
Results.Title: Now we're cookin'

Results.ReviewText: I can really tell the quality is much better than previous cheaper grills I have owned. Heats up very quickly.
Results.Title: Good quality.

Results.ReviewText:
I just bought the Weber 210 yesterday took 2 hrs to assemble.  Instructions were clear and did not have to redo...lol 
Did my first bbq on it and great.  
perfect for condo living.  like the side panels fold down a great space saver
Results.Title: Happy purchase do far

Results.ReviewText: I have had my Spirit E-210 grill for about two months, have used it at least twice a week and absolutely love it. Great features, simple to use and cooks meals flawlessly. Highly recommend!
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is the perfect sized grill for our 2 person household. The compact design and fold down side tables make it easy to store. The 4 wheel casters also make it very easy to relocate on my deck. I am very pleased with this grill! It heats up quickly and evenly. So far I've enjoyed it for direct heat cooking and indirect heat cooking. I've also used a grill mat on top to make fajitas, which has been awesome. Very pleased with this purchase. Easy to keep clean.
Results.Title: Perfect size for 2 people

Results.ReviewText: My Weber grill replaced a Char-Broil Red IR that was extremely flimsy seem like substandard material and did not last very long. I really like the engineering and the sturdiness of this grill. It was a bit more expensive I feel that expense was certainly taken up by the higher quality and performance so far. Five or six cookouts so far and I am really happy with my purchase.
Results.Title: Very well built

Results.ReviewText:
Like most weber grills this unit is a great grill.
The fold down side shelves is great for conserving space on my small deck.
Like all weber grills not sure why temperature drops so dramatically when I open top to add food or flip but fortunately I dont  open much.
Results.Title: Solid weber product fold down shelves huge plus

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill as a fathers day gift for my boyfriend and I am the one using it the most because of its ease to light and overall quality grilling.
Results.Title: Best Grill Ever!

Results.ReviewText: I never quite got grilling right with meals either burnt or undercooked.  Using this grill has made the process so much easier!
Results.Title: Great Little Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I have had many other grills but this one is solid. It cooks well for only having 2 burners and has plenty of space for tools/dishes.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Bought this grill,cooked on it a few times now and love it!!
Results.Title: Awesome grill

Results.ReviewText: My new grill was a Father’s Day gift. No hot spots. Works great. Definitely would recommend this grill.
Results.Title: Excellent Grill

Results.ReviewText: Best Grill that I have Ever owned! Has all the features to grill well.
Results.Title: Does It All

Results.ReviewText:
Would highly recomment this grill to anyone looking to buy a new grill.
The quality is superior and it cooks everything to perfection.
Results.Title: BEST GRILL EVER!

Results.ReviewText: Bought other brand name for years and had to buy parts every year but this grill is good for 10 years.
Results.Title: New grill

Results.ReviewText: We have really enjoyed this barbecue.  It heats up fast and heats evenly throughout the grilling area.
Results.Title: Excellent barbecue!

Results.ReviewText: This is our 4th Weber grill and love it!.  Cleaning ability and performance are exceptional.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: I am 65. You have to hold door open and put the tank on a hook inside  Have to set on the ground and drag around tank to heavy for me to lift on hook on left side inside. $500 with tax and cover.  Waste of money
Results.Title: Very disappointed

Results.ReviewText: Great grill, heats up fast to 400 or more. Easy to use. Ace Hardware delivered and set up.
Results.Title: Grease catcher could be better

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill and has been awesome. The grill does and exceeds my expectations.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: I love my new grill! I love the cabinet underneath! It’s very functional and just the right size.
Results.Title: Great features

Results.ReviewText: Beautiful and compact. My wife and I barbecue about two to three times a week and this is perfect.
Results.Title: Size doesn’t always matter!

Results.ReviewText: The weber system of grilling is completely different from how i learned to grill, sear low and slow. Weber is high temp sear don't open again and take off in 10 mins or less. While my family is happier with taste of protein coming off the grill,  I  miss the 30 to 50 minutes of grilling.  The Weber style is more like an outdoor door oven that sears meat and cooks very fast.
Results.Title: Great  introduction to weber

Results.ReviewText: The locking wheels are too small to go over even a 1/2 inch bump from a threshold without catching the wheel lock. Really cuts down on maneuverability.
Results.Title: Love the grill, hate the wheels.

Results.ReviewText: La bonne grandeur, la cuisson est parfaite rencontre mes attentes
Results.Title: Très bon achat

Results.ReviewText: I purchased in box and assembled myself. I really love this grill. But in the box, wrong side tables inside. I bought model with drop down side tables. Customer service called and they quickly shipped the correct side tables. Weird..packaging issue but promptly fixed. Don’t like the plastic parts though..lid handle and knobs. Weird they would design with plastic when everything else is a metal.
Results.Title: Happy Grill

Results.ReviewText: I bought a Weber after having a no name inexpensive grill for many years. I am amazed at the difference in the cooking process, heats distributed evenly and everything cooks exactly as timed with no burning or overcooking. Clean up is a breeze. Love this grill.
Results.Title: Even heat distribution

Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill to replace a Weber Genisis Silver.
Results.Title: great grill

Results.ReviewText: Struggled between the two and three burner version. For a variety of reasons (not related to the function of the grill) I wish I bought the three burner.  The Spirit Two has been a solid little grill.  It heats up quickly and cooks evenly.  I have grilled steaks, burgers, ribs, chicken, veggies and shrimp.  All have turned out great.
Results.Title: Solid Little Grill

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
